#### Defining Profiles

To define a profile, the declaration `Profile` and keyword `Parent` are REQUIRED, and `Id`, `Title`, and `Description` are RECOMMENDED. Profile metadata that does not have a dedicated keyword MAY be specified using assignment rules with [caret paths](04-paths.md#caret-paths) (e.g., `^url`, `^status`, `^purpose`). Rules defining the profile follow immediately after the keyword section.

Rules types that apply to Profiles are: [Assignment](20-rules-assignment.md#assignment-rules), [Binding](21-rules-binding.md#binding-rules), [Cardinality](22-rules-cardinality.md#cardinality-rules), [Contains (standalone extensions)](23-rules-contains-rules-for-extensions.md#contains-rules-for-extensions), [Contains (slicing)](24-rules-contains-rules-for-slicing.md#contains-rules-for-slicing), [Flag](26-rules-flag.md#flag-rules), [Insert](28-rules-insert.md#insert-rules), [Obeys](31-rules-obeys.md#obeys-rules), [Path](32-rules-path.md#path-rules), and [Type](33-rules-type.md#type-rules). Note that [inline extensions](23-rules-contains-rules-for-extensions.md#contains-rules-for-extensions) are not permitted in profiles.

**Example:**

* Define a profile for exposure to a pathogen:

  ```
  Profile:        KnownExposureSetting
  Parent:         Observation
  Id:             known-exposure-setting
  Title:          "Known Exposure Setting Profile"
  Description:    "The setting where an individual was exposed to a contagion."
  // url, status, purpose, and other metadata could be defined here using caret syntax (omitted)
  * code = $LNC#81267-7 // Setting of exposure to illness
  * value[x] only CodeableConcept
  * value[x] from https://loinc.org/vs/LL3991-8 (extensible)
  ```
